title: A breath of fresh air
description: Your crew needs oxygen. The recycler can help, but it uses electricity. How will you power today's life support?

choices.label: Run the oxygen recycler
choices.description: Make more oxygen using stored power.
choices.explanation: Life-support equipment needs electricity to produce and recycle breathable air. You gained oxygen, but spent power that other equipment also needs.

choices.label: Use the oxygen reserve
choices.description: Save electricity and breathe from your backup supply.
choices.explanation: Using stored oxygen lets you save electricity today. The trade-off is a smaller oxygen reserve for tomorrow.

title: A warning from the Sun
description: A simulated solar-particle alert interrupts the mission. Bring the crew inside, or spend more time collecting energy?

choices.label: Move into the storm shelter
choices.description: Use power for shelter life support and keep exposure low.
choices.explanation: Shielding can reduce exposure to energetic particles. Sheltering the crew still needs power for life support. This scenario is simulated, not a live space-weather alert.

choices.label: Collect power outside
choices.description: Gain energy, but expose the crew to more radiation.
choices.explanation: Outside work can support mission tasks, but during a solar-particle event it can increase exposure. The crew also uses oxygen while working. These are game points, not radiation-dose measurements.

title: Plan the final day's supplies
description: The greenhouse has a crop ready to harvest. Use power to run its equipment, or spend the day boosting the energy supply?

choices.label: Power the greenhouse
choices.description: Harvest an already-grown crop and support the air system.
choices.explanation: Plants can provide food and contribute oxygen, but a controlled growing environment needs energy. Your crop was grown before this mission; it did not grow in one day.

choices.label: Work on the solar array
choices.description: Collect more power, using crew supplies and time outside.
choices.explanation: Maintaining solar equipment can improve the power supply. Outside work uses crew supplies and adds exposure, so the right choice depends on your remaining resources.
